title: Arkret CBS Proof Bundle
description: Unsigned receiver-relative container for one target Realm. Voting replicas and replay auditors require full original dependencies. Non-voting consumers may use authenticated conclusion_set under cbs-profiles section 9, with empty replay arrays. Every supplied original object remains independently validated and authorized; omitted irrelevant history is not required by conclusion consumption. The exact target must be covered by a certificate; certificates for historical prerequisites remain independently scoped. Existing proof/depth/byte budgets still apply.

control_moves.description: Control Move Event envelopes only. Semantic validation MUST reject ordinary Event, Anchor Unit, actor-private, or unknown non-control Event shapes even when the generic Event Envelope schema is otherwise valid.

inclusion_proofs.description: Inclusion proofs. The combined item count of this array and availability_proofs MUST be no greater than 2048.

availability_proofs.description: Availability proofs. The combined item count of this array and inclusion_proofs MUST be no greater than 2048.
